answer_1.quote: we propose our model CAVE (Controllable Authorship Verification Explanations), an in-house model that generates authorship predictions along with high-quality, free-text rationales that explain the former post-hoc.
answer_1.outputs: structured free-text rationales in JSON format with intermediate linguistic feature analysis

answer_2.quote: We also introduce our automatic metric CONS-R-L that measures the consistency between the rationale and the model's final label; CONS-R-L is used to filter the silver train data before finetuning, and also assess CAVE during inference.

answer_4.quote: we opted to conduct a small but high-quality in-house human study... We pick 50 document pairs per dataset (total of 150 pairs) and evaluate the rationales generated by their corresponding CAVE. We employ 3 distinct annotators per datapoint.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated rationales via three properties: Detail-Consistency, Factual-Correctness, and Label-Consistency, providing comments on unsatisfactory instances.
